about_the_game:
Welcome to Tango District: Demo Edition — Where Control Begins

Experience the first taste of Tango District, a cyberpunk city builder where every placement counts and every decision shapes your fate.
This demo lets you explore the initial gameplay loop and experiment with the game’s core puzzle–strategy mechanics.

🏙️ What’s Included in the Demo

  • A lot of buildings to experiment how your placement converts to your city

  • A Single corporate factions to interact with offering unique deals and demands

  • Mission system introducing the economic loop and risk of bankruptcy

  • Core city-building puzzle mechanics — place buildings to raise your district score and unlock new tiles

  • Approx. 20–60 minutes of playtime depending on your strategy

🚫 Not Included in the Demo

  • Mid- to late-game corporations and advanced building tiers

  • Story progression and branching CEO relationships

  • Unique gameplay based on each corporation

🎮 Features Supported

  • Languages: Spanish/English

  • Player modes: Single player only

🎬 About the Demo Experience

This demo is designed to give players a strategic slice of the full experience — showing how city-building, mission management, and corporate interactions combine into a replayable loop.

Your progress will not carry over to the full game.

content_descriptors.notes: The game world is depicted as a distopic cyberpunk world in which drug/sex consuption is a normal behaviour, while in the game it does not show any content of such, you might find billboards and such depicting those stores.

short_description: A cyberpunk puzzle city builder where corporations vie for control. Build, earn, and negotiate your way through missions, milestones, and moral dilemmas... all under the neon-lit shadow of corporate ambition.
